scope: One MicroB data plug; Pi receives power through GPIO so adjacent PWR port stays empty
supplier: SC0727 publishes overall cable length, not complete moulded-plug dimensions
envelope_meaning: Acceptable external plug bounding box for this printed opening; not a measured or manufacturer-warranted SC0727 size
received_part_check: Before final cap closure, confirm the actual SC0727 moulding plus insulation lies inside the declared 25 x 18 x 8 mm envelope; use a smooth service loop outside the cap. If only wider or longer, revise the local window from measured dimensions. A plug taller than 8 mm requires reviewing the internal Pi/controller spacing; enlarging the plastic window alone cannot resolve an internal collision.
